query: Set up a migration project called acme-migration from https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/old to https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/new.
expected_behavior: Calls setup_migration_project(repo_root, source_site_url=..., target_site_url=..., project_slug='acme-migration') with scripts/ on sys.path
Creates runs/sharepoint-site-migration/acme-migration/ with export/ and generated-scripts/ and reports the outcome

expected_behavior: Reports Outcome.FAILED for a missing config.psd1 and creates no working directory
Declines to generate a competing connection config
Routes the user to workbench-initialize-connection-config, which owns config.psd1
